contents.contents: Normally, Vespers, Compline and Lauds (ܪܡܫܐ، ܣܘܬܪܐ ܘܨܦܪܐ) for a) saint Marūn, fol. 2r-17v; b) john Marūn, fol. 18r-40v; c) the death of Joseph, fol. 40v-58v; d) sunday of Rosary (with ܠܠܝܐ ܘܬܠܬܫ̈ܥܝܢ), fol. 58v-93v; e) all saints day (without ܣܘܬܪܐ), fol. 93v-106r; f) the conception of Anne, mother of Mary, fol. 106r-124r; g) glorification of Mary (ܩܘܠܣܗ̇ ܕܡܪܝܡ) fol. 124r-141v; h) another rite for Mary (ܢܨܚܢܗ̇ ܕܡܪܝܡ), fol. 141v-163r; i) saint Anthony of Egypt, fol. 163r-184r; j) holy Trinity, fol. 184r-200v; k) eucharist, fol. 200v-219r; l) commemoration of the Priests, fol. 219r-234; m) commeration of the Righteous and the Just, fol. 235r-252v; n) commemoration of the Faithful Departed, fol. 252r-270r; o) sunday (ܪܡܫܐ ܘܣܘܬܪܐ) and monday (ܪܡܫܐ ܘܨܦܪܐ) of the Glorious Ressurection, fol. 270r-295r; p) new Sunday, fol. 295v-313; q) ascension of the Lord, fol. 313v-332r; r) sunday and monday of the Pentecost, fol. 332v-368r; s) peter and Paul, fol. 368-388v
contents.notes: The text was reviewed by الاب نعمة الله الكفري اللبناني as on fol. 388v; fol. 1rv did not belong to the original MS; the end binding leaf contains a syriac liturgical text

contents.notes: The MS relates to the Syro-Catholic church
